recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No follow-up is needed for FHIR-18665 unless a future work group decision changes ValueSet compose.exclude semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-18665 was a Published vocab Change Request for STU3 ValueSet text. It originally requested a sentence requiring any compose.exclude process to occur after all compose.include processing, but the Persuasive with Modification resolution reworded this as an outcome rule: any compose.exclude SHALL be processed such that excluded codes are not found in the expansion.
initial_application: The Jira comment points to git 4907f9bcb0b710cb2837a93a20c4b23210a37249, a terminology ballot documentation update that added the resolved sentence to source/valueset/valueset-notes.xml. The current source still retains that sentence.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists valueset=ValueSet in the active [resources] section, confirming the checked ValueSet notes are current build input. The expansion algorithm also says compose.exclude follows the include process but removes codes instead of adding them. Zulip and Confluence searches found no FHIR-18665-specific discussion that changes this conclusion; one later Vocab minutes hit cited the sentence only as an existing requirement in a separate supplement-rule topic.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Adding the originally requested process-order sentence would be less accurate than the Jira resolution because the resolution explicitly says the actual processing order does not matter as long as excluded codes are absent from the expansion.
